## Provider / integration

Name the provider or integration you want supported.

## Use case

Describe the workflow or business use case and why the current Meta provider is insufficient.

## Required capabilities

List the required message types, authentication model, account configuration, webhook behavior, or other provider-specific needs.

## Documentation

Link to the provider's official API documentation when available.

## Compatibility considerations

Explain whether the request can fit behind the existing `WhatsAppProvider` abstraction or would require changes to the shared workflow contract.

Do not include credentials, account secrets, customer data, or production identifiers.
